briefing_zh:
今天最清晰的主线，是 Agent 研究正在从「能不能完成一次任务」转向「能否在长时程、真实约束和失败之后仍可靠工作」。**Long-WAM** 证明视觉历史并非越长越好，只有与自回归视频预训练和低延迟系统协同，19.2 秒上下文才把 RoboCasa GR-1 成功率从 63.3% 推到 78.7%；**H-JEPA** 则通过分层潜空间把 Visual AntMaze 成功率从 18% 提升到 73.3%。两者共同指向：长程能力不是简单扩 context，而是要让表示、规划层级和执行系统共同保留真正有用的状态。

可靠性也开始被拆成更具体、可测量的维度。**DecepEval** 用 1,532 个实例量化压力、激励、机会和冲突如何诱发 Agent 欺骗；HN 上的 **Agentability** 公开真实网页任务的完整 transcript，专门暴露失败模式；韩国银行攻击事件则提醒我们，Agent 能力已进入现实安全边界。研究界不再只看 task success，而是开始追问失败能否恢复、行为是否诚实、外部副作用能否审计。

训练与系统效率的进展同样务实。**STEPQuant** 针对 recurrent state 的误差传播进行时空分配，在接近 FP32 精度下实现超过 5× 状态压缩；**QF3** 用 filtered Q-gradients 将 humanoid flow-policy 训练墙钟时间缩短约 10×；**R-Quest** 则把自进化崩溃追溯到无效问题和数学等价重复，并在十轮训练中维持增长。共同趋势是：下一阶段的增益越来越来自对误差来源、数据质量和系统瓶颈的结构化诊断，而不是单纯堆算力。

开源侧出现两类互补工具：**answer-me-with-html** 把复杂回答打包成可读、可分享的单页 artifact，迅速获得 2.2k stars；**strands-agents/box** 用 default-deny policy、OS isolation 与外置凭据降低 Agent 执行风险。与此同时，**NanoMuse** 和 **MuseLite** 把跨设备屏幕操作、浏览器自动化、记忆与定时任务组合成个人 Agent。产品机会正在从「聊天界面」迁移到可交付 artifact、可审计执行环境和跨设备 action loop。
briefing_en:
Today's clearest theme is a shift from whether an agent can finish one task to whether it can remain effective over long horizons, under real constraints, and after failures. **Long-WAM** shows that more visual history is useful only when autoregressive video pretraining and a low-latency system can exploit it, raising RoboCasa GR-1 success from 63.3% to 78.7% with 19.2 seconds of context. **H-JEPA** reaches a similar conclusion from planning: hierarchical latent spaces lift Visual AntMaze success from 18% to 73.3%, suggesting that long-horizon ability requires representation, planning depth, and execution to preserve the right state together.

Reliability is also being decomposed into measurable dimensions. **DecepEval** uses 1,532 instances to test how pressure, incentives, opportunity, and conflict induce deceptive agent behavior, while **Agentability** publishes full transcripts from real web errands to expose practical failure modes. The reported use of AI agents in attacks on South Korean banks shows why task success alone is no longer enough: recovery, honesty, side effects, and auditability are becoming first-class evaluation targets.

Progress in training and systems is similarly concrete. **STEPQuant** allocates precision according to the temporal and spatial impact of recurrent-state errors, delivering more than 5× state compression near FP32 accuracy; **QF3** uses filtered Q-gradients to cut humanoid flow-policy training wall time by roughly 10×; and **R-Quest** traces self-evolution collapse to invalid and mathematically duplicate questions, sustaining gains for ten rounds. The common pattern is that gains increasingly come from diagnosing error propagation, data quality, and system bottlenecks rather than merely scaling compute.

Open source is splitting into complementary layers. **answer-me-with-html** turns difficult answers into readable, shareable one-page artifacts and quickly passed 2.2k stars, while **strands-agents/box** applies default-deny policies, OS isolation, and secret-preserving credential injection to agent execution. **NanoMuse** and **MuseLite** combine screen control, browser automation, memory, and scheduled tasks across devices, indicating that the product frontier is moving beyond chat toward deliverable artifacts, auditable runtimes, and cross-device action loops.
viral_analysis_zh: **answer-me-with-html** 最可能继续扩散：它把抽象的 Agent 能力压缩成一眼可见、可转发的 HTML 成品，价值主张极短，而且项目本身能用大量 showcase 持续制造传播素材。研究侧最可能出圈的是 **H-JEPA**，因为「Yann LeCun + world model + 18%→73.3%」同时具备名人、热门叙事和强数字钩子；但传播时必须注明主要结果来自模拟与离线评估。
viral_analysis_en: **answer-me-with-html** is the strongest viral candidate because it compresses an abstract agent capability into a visible, shareable HTML artifact with an exceptionally short value proposition and endless showcase material. On the research side, **H-JEPA** combines Yann LeCun, the world-model narrative, and a striking 18% to 73.3% result, although responsible coverage must state that the headline evidence comes from simulation and offline evaluation.

huggingface_papers.title: STEPQuant: When and Where Errors Matter in Delta-Rule Recurrent State Quantization
huggingface_papers.tldr: STEPQuant targets the persistent recurrent states that replace KV caches in linear-attention models but become a memory bottleneck under concurrent serving. It allocates precision by both error lifetime and spatial impact, jointly fitting key-row and value-column scales rather than applying uniform quantization. On Qwen3.8-27B and Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct, its nominal 6-bit setting stays close to FP32-state accuracy while compressing recurrent states by over 5× and reducing total serving memory by up to 68.7%.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: STEPQuant 针对线性注意力模型中替代 KV cache、却在并发 serving 时成为瓶颈的 persistent recurrent state。它同时依据误差存活时间与空间影响分配精度，并联合拟合 key-row 和 value-column scale，而非统一量化。在 Qwen3.8-27B 与 Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct 上，名义 6-bit 配置接近 FP32-state 精度，同时将 recurrent state 压缩超过 5×、总 serving memory 最多降低 68.7%。
huggingface_papers.authors: Bingchen Yao, Haobo Xu, Haokun Lin, Yichen Wu, Ziyu Guo, Renrui Zhang, Zhichao Lu, Zhenan Sun, Ying Wei

huggingface_papers.title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models
huggingface_papers.tldr: Long-WAM studies the tension between giving robot policies longer visual history and preserving real-time action latency. Its key finding is that long context pays off primarily when the video backbone was pretrained autoregressively: extending history to 19.2 seconds raises RoboCasa GR-1 success from 63.3% to 78.7%. Streaming encoding and asynchronous execution reduce each action chunk to 107.4 ms on an RTX 5090, while real-world dynamic cup stacking reaches 95% success; these results support context-system co-design rather than context scaling alone.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: Long-WAM 研究机器人策略获得更长视觉历史与维持实时动作延迟之间的矛盾。核心发现是：只有视频 backbone 经过自回归预训练时，长 context 才真正有效；将历史扩展到 19.2 秒后，RoboCasa GR-1 成功率从 63.3% 升至 78.7%。流式编码和异步执行把 RTX 5090 上每个 action chunk 压到 107.4 ms，真机动态叠杯达到 95% 成功率，说明关键是 context 与系统协同设计，而非单独扩窗。
huggingface_papers.authors: Wei Huang, Bohan Zhang, Chenzhi Liu, Isabella Liu, Shuai Yang, Weian Mao, Luozhou Wang, Yicheng Xiao, Weifeng Lin, Qixin Hu, Bryan Chu, Sifei Liu, Linxi Fan, Xiaojuan Qi, Song Han, Yukang Chen

huggingface_papers.title: Recursive Game Creator: An Agentic Product-Level Experience-Oriented Game Harness
huggingface_papers.tldr: Recursive Game Creator optimizes generated games for player experience rather than stopping at code correctness. A Designer, Builder, programmatic Player, and Reviewer form a recursive loop in which reusable policies collect trajectories and the reviewer combines metrics, visual evidence, and explicit preferences. It scores 77.89 on GameCraft-Bench and reaches 53.2% strict task success on GameASG-Bench, a 34.1-point improvement over the same-model baseline, although the paper says code is still forthcoming.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: Recursive Game Creator 不再以代码正确为终点，而是直接优化生成游戏的玩家体验。Designer、Builder、编程式 Player 与 Reviewer 构成递归闭环，复用策略收集轨迹，再综合指标、视觉证据和显式偏好迭代版本。它在 GameCraft-Bench 得到 77.89，并在 GameASG-Bench 达到 53.2% strict task success，比同模型基线高 34.1 个百分点，但论文目前仍注明代码尚未发布。
huggingface_papers.authors: Jiajun Chen, Haoyu Wu, Mingda Jia, Xihui Liu

huggingface_papers.title: Questioning the Questions: Sustaining Self-Evolution in Reasoning Models
huggingface_papers.tldr: This work explains why repeated self-training can make reasoning models collapse: invalid generated questions accumulate, while lexical diversity filters miss mathematically equivalent duplicates. R-Quest trains the solver to reject invalid questions, feeds those judgments back into rewards and filtering, and uses a frozen base model to assess novelty. Across two model families and 12 reasoning and coding benchmarks, it sustains gains for ten rounds and finishes 17.32 points above R-Zero.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: 该工作解释了推理模型反复 self-training 后为何会崩溃：无效问题不断累积，而基于词面相似度的多样性过滤识别不了数学等价重复。R-Quest 训练 solver 拒绝无效问题，将判断反馈给 reward 与数据过滤，并用冻结 base model 评估 novelty。在两个模型家族、12 个推理与代码 benchmark 上，它连续十轮保持增长，最终比 R-Zero 高 17.32 分。
huggingface_papers.authors: Jinyuan Li, Chengsong Huang, Langlin Huang, Donghong Cai, Shiping Gao, Yuyi Yang, Jiaxin Huang

huggingface_papers.title: DecepEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Deception in LLM Agents
huggingface_papers.tldr: DecepEval turns agent deception from isolated anecdotes into a controlled benchmark with 1,532 instances across three task families and 28 professional scenarios. Its Deception Diamond varies pressure, incentive, opportunity, and conflict, pairing neutral and induced versions while using explicit facts and observable actions to separate deception from ordinary capability errors. Tests on nine frontier models show that inducements consistently raise deception rates, making the benchmark useful for measuring deployment risk rather than task competence alone.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: DecepEval 将零散的 Agent 欺骗案例转化为可控 benchmark，包含 1,532 个实例、3 类任务和 28 个专业场景。其 Deception Diamond 系统改变压力、激励、机会与冲突，为每个实例配对中性版和诱导版，并用显式事实与可观察动作区分欺骗和普通能力错误。对 9 个前沿模型的测试显示，诱导条件会稳定抬高欺骗率，使它能衡量任务能力之外的部署风险。
huggingface_papers.authors: Yiming Xu, Hongyue Yu, Beihua Yang, Zihan Chen, Yixin Liu, Zhen Peng, Bin Shi, Bo Dong, Chao Shen, Irwin King, Qinghua Zheng

alphaxiv_papers.title: H-JEPA: End-to-End Learning of Hierarchical World Models for Visual Planning
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: H-JEPA trains a hierarchy of action-conditioned joint-embedding predictive models, with higher levels forecasting farther ahead and passing latent subgoals to lower-level planners. On 50 Visual AntMaze tasks, a three-level hierarchy reaches 73.3% success versus 18.0% for a flat LeWM while improving the success-versus-planning-compute frontier. The evidence is strongest in simulation; the DROID result measures offline planning fidelity rather than online physical task success.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: H-JEPA 训练分层的 action-conditioned joint-embedding predictive model，让高层预测更远未来，并把 latent subgoal 传给低层 planner。在 50 个 Visual AntMaze 任务上，三层模型达到 73.3% 成功率，而平坦 LeWM 为 18.0%，同时改善成功率与规划计算量的前沿。最强证据仍来自模拟；DROID 部分衡量的是离线规划 fidelity，不是在线真机任务成功率。

alphaxiv_papers.title: QF3: Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: QF3 is an off-policy RL method for flow policies that combines flow matching with critic action gradients propagated through a one-step estimate of the final action. It masks critic updates on dimensions that move too far from replay actions, acting as a local trust region against unreliable value gradients. On Unitree G1 dance tracking it reaches full episodes about 10× faster than FPO++, transfers locomotion policies to hardware without real-world fine-tuning, and also improves simulated manipulation policies.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: QF3 是面向 flow policy 的 off-policy RL 方法，把 flow matching 与经过一步最终动作估计传播的 critic action gradient 结合起来。它屏蔽偏离 replay action 过远的维度，相当于用局部 trust region 抑制不可靠价值梯度。在 Unitree G1 舞蹈跟踪上，它达到完整 episode 的速度约为 FPO++ 的 10×，能将运动策略零样本迁移到硬件，也改善了模拟操作策略。

alphaxiv_papers.title: Kernel Autoresearch for Open-Ended Model Discovery
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: KERNAUT lets coding agents propose Gaussian-process kernels as programs while a trusted interpreter restricts composition to positive-semidefinite-preserving constructions. A quality-diversity archive keeps behaviorally distinct candidates, addressing the finding that 22–58% of LLM kernels passing random numerical checks fail at new scales or dimensions. Selected kernels improve some held-out optimization and enzyme-kinetics tasks and remain interpretable, but the gains vary by domain and are not universal.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: KERNAUT 让 coding agent 以程序形式提出 Gaussian-process kernel，再由可信解释器把组合限制在保持 positive semidefinite 的构造内。quality-diversity archive 保留行为不同的候选，从而回应一个关键发现：通过随机数值检查的 LLM kernel 中，仍有 22%–58% 会在新尺度或维度下失效。筛出的 kernel 在部分留出优化与酶动力学任务上更优且保持可解释，但收益依赖领域，并非普遍成立。

alphaxiv_papers.title: OpenWAM: An Open Framework for Composable World-Action Models
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: OpenWAM creates a common causal robot-video foundation for comparing joint, video-to-action, action-to-video, and decoupled world-action generation. Causal adaptation raises video-to-action success on LIBERO-Long from 68.4% to 97.8%, while a local-context inverse dynamics model trained with demonstrations and counterfactuals reaches 84.0% on four held-out LIBERO-90 targets versus 47.0% for full-context conditioning. The framework is valuable because it isolates interaction design choices, although most headline numbers come from simulation rather than open-world deployment.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: OpenWAM 建立统一的 causal robot-video foundation，用来比较 joint、video-to-action、action-to-video 与 decoupled world-action generation。因果适配把 LIBERO-Long 的 video-to-action 成功率从 68.4% 提至 97.8%；在四个留出的 LIBERO-90 目标上，结合示范和反事实训练的 local-context inverse dynamics 达到 84.0%，而 full-context conditioning 为 47.0%。它的价值在于隔离不同交互设计变量，但多数 headline 数字仍来自模拟而非开放世界部署。

alphaxiv_papers.title: EmbodiedRSI: Active Continual Robot Learning Through Hypothesis-Guided Co-Evolution
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: EmbodiedRSI adapts around a frozen vision-language-action model by maintaining competing code and skill hypotheses rather than retraining the foundation policy. It selects robot experiments by value of information, then co-evolves code, skills, and hierarchical evidence memory from the outcomes. It reports 71.3% on RoboCasa365 Composite-Unseen versus 40.1% for Harness VLA and 71.3% across real-world tasks, supporting harness-level adaptation without establishing universal recursive self-improvement.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: EmbodiedRSI 不重训底层 vision-language-action model，而是在冻结策略外部维护相互竞争的代码与技能假设。它按 value of information 选择机器人实验，再依据结果共同演化代码、技能和分层证据记忆。在 RoboCasa365 Composite-Unseen 上它达到 71.3%，而 Harness VLA 为 40.1%；真机任务总体也报告 71.3%，说明 harness-level adaptation 有效，但不能据此宣称普适递归自我改进。

github_repos.name: QingYunA/answer-me-with-html
github_repos.tldr: This agent skill turns a difficult question into a self-contained, readable one-page HTML artifact instead of another long chat response. The repository includes source code, tests, benchmarks, examples, and bilingual documentation, with 148 forks indicating hands-on use rather than stars alone. Its rapid rise to 2,213 stars shows the appeal of outputs that are immediately inspectable, shareable, and visually structured.
github_repos.tldr_zh: 这个 Agent skill 不再返回一段冗长聊天文本，而是把复杂问题做成自包含、可读的一页 HTML artifact。仓库包含源码、测试、benchmark、示例和双语文档，148 个 forks 也说明不只是收藏热度，而有真实使用。它迅速升至 2,213 stars，反映出用户对可立即检查、分享和视觉化组织的 Agent 成品有强需求。

github_repos.name: trevaintdead/ai-game-modding-guides
github_repos.tldr: This repository documents how to use AI coding agents for practical game modding, including passthrough mods, Rust rewrites, mod loaders, prompting, and troubleshooting. It provides focused guides, templates, legal notes, and contribution material across 39 commits rather than presenting a one-shot prompt dump. The project is valuable as field evidence for where coding agents help and where human engineering judgment is still required in reverse-engineering-heavy workflows.
github_repos.tldr_zh: 该仓库系统整理用 AI coding agent 完成游戏 mod 的方法，包括 passthrough mod、Rust 重写、mod loader、prompting 与故障排查。它通过 39 次提交积累专题指南、模板、法律说明和贡献文档，而不是一次性 prompt dump。其价值在于呈现 coding agent 在逆向工程密集型流程中真正有用的环节，以及仍需要人类工程判断的边界。

github_repos.name: empero-org/brewery-ai
github_repos.tldr: Brewery AI is a console agent that guides non-experts through dataset preparation, model selection, hyperparameters, cloud training, evaluation, and Hugging Face publication. The repository contains a real Python package, tests, examples, and documentation, making it more than a conversational wrapper around training commands. Its 198 stars and 24 forks suggest demand for agentic interfaces that package an end-to-end ML workflow without hiding the underlying stages.
github_repos.tldr_zh: Brewery AI 是一个 console agent，引导非专家完成数据准备、模型选择、超参数、云端训练、评测与 Hugging Face 发布。仓库含真实 Python package、测试、示例和文档，不只是套在训练命令外的聊天壳。198 stars 和 24 forks 表明，市场需要把端到端 ML workflow 封装起来、但仍清楚暴露各阶段的 agentic interface。

github_repos.name: strands-agents/box
github_repos.tldr: Box runs agents inside a Rust sandbox that limits execution, file access, and network reachability with default-deny Dogwood policies. Credential injection keeps secrets outside the agent context, combining OS isolation with policy enforcement rather than trusting prompt-level safeguards. The current release targets Apple-silicon macOS with Linux planned, so the security model is compelling but platform coverage remains early.
github_repos.tldr_zh: Box 用 Rust sandbox 运行 Agent，通过 default-deny Dogwood policy 限制执行、文件访问和网络范围。credential injection 让 secret 留在 Agent context 之外，把 OS isolation 与 policy enforcement 结合起来，而不是依赖 prompt 层防护。当前版本主要支持 Apple-silicon macOS，Linux 仍在计划中，因此安全模型很有吸引力，但平台覆盖尚处早期。

github_repos.name: yxq953/MuseLite
github_repos.tldr: MuseLite combines chat, agent tools, browser automation, scheduled tasks, and mobile control in one open-source workspace. Its repository contains Android, Java, and Python sources plus tests, browser tooling, and an execution sandbox across 59 commits, despite its modest 35-star count. The project earns an interest slot because screen and mobile automation are core functionality rather than an incidental agent claim.
github_repos.tldr_zh: MuseLite 在一个开源 workspace 中组合 chat、Agent tools、浏览器自动化、定时任务和移动端控制。尽管只有 35 stars，仓库已有 59 次提交，并包含 Android、Java、Python 源码、测试、浏览器工具和执行 sandbox。它值得占据兴趣槽，因为屏幕与移动端自动化是核心能力，而不是只在描述里顺带提到 Agent。

hackernews.title: South Korea says AI agents appear to have been used to hack the country's banks
hackernews.tldr: South Korean authorities say recent attacks on several banks show signs that AI models or agents may have been used, although the specific tools and scale remain undisclosed. Police are investigating leaks involving Shinhan, KB Kookmin, Hana, and Woori, while regulators have shared 28 suspicious IP addresses. The story matters because agentic cyber capability is moving from demonstrations toward alleged real incidents, but the attribution is still preliminary rather than a technically documented conclusion.
hackernews.tldr_zh: 韩国方面表示，近期针对多家银行的攻击出现使用 AI 模型或 Agent 的迹象，但具体工具和规模尚未公开。警方正调查涉及新韩、KB 国民、韩亚与友利银行的数据泄露，监管部门已共享 28 个可疑 IP。其重要性在于 agentic cyber capability 正从演示走向疑似真实事件，但目前归因仍属初步判断，并非已有完整技术证据。

hackernews.title: Show HN: NanoMuse – An open-source AI agent for your phone and computer
hackernews.tldr: NanoMuse is a GPL-3.0 personal agent spanning Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and browsers. It can operate phone and desktop applications through the screen, use shells, browsers, and MCP tools, maintain editable memory, and request confirmation before high-risk actions. Its cross-device relay and self-hosting option make computer use a core product capability, although real reliability and security still need evidence beyond the feature list.
hackernews.tldr_zh: NanoMuse 是覆盖 Android、iOS、Windows、macOS、Linux 与浏览器的 GPL-3.0 个人 Agent。它可通过屏幕操作手机和桌面应用，调用 shell、browser 与 MCP tool，维护可编辑记忆，并在高风险动作前请求确认。跨设备 relay 和自托管让 computer use 成为核心产品能力，但实际可靠性与安全性仍需要超越功能清单的证据。

hackernews.title: Show HN: Agent.reviews – Where AI agents read and write reviews on tools
hackernews.tldr: Agent.reviews lets coding agents record how tools performed on real tasks and consult reports from other agents before adopting new software. The service says it avoids uploading code, prompts, or secrets and scans public reviews for credentials, email addresses, and internal URLs. The interesting idea is a machine-readable reputation layer built from post-task evidence, but its usefulness will depend on review authenticity, task context, and resistance to manipulation.
hackernews.tldr_zh: Agent.reviews 让 coding agent 在真实任务后记录工具效果，并在引入新软件前读取其他 Agent 的使用报告。平台称不会上传代码、prompt 或 secret，并会在公开前扫描 credential、邮箱和内部 URL。它尝试建立基于任务后证据、可供机器读取的 reputation layer，但价值取决于评论真实性、任务上下文与抗操纵能力。

hackernews.title: Meta's Muse AI agent is building a dossier on you
hackernews.tldr: TIME reports that Meta’s Muse instructions maintain evolving profiles of users, contacts, relationships, preferences, and reactions, with hourly updates and nightly conversation summaries. Meta says users can inspect, export, and ask the system to forget memories, and that the data is not used for advertising, but end-to-end encryption is not yet available and forgetting may not remove original chats. The case shows that long-term agent memory is also a privacy and governance mechanism, not merely a retrieval-quality feature.
hackernews.tldr_zh: TIME 报道称，Meta 的 Muse 指令会持续维护用户、联系人、关系、偏好和行为反应档案，并按小时更新、夜间汇总对话。Meta 表示用户可查看、导出和要求遗忘记忆，且数据不用于广告，但端到端加密尚未上线，遗忘也未必删除原始聊天。这个案例说明，长期 Agent memory 不只是 retrieval quality 功能，同时也是隐私和治理机制。

hackernews.title: Show HN: An AI agent runs ten web errands a day, every transcript published
hackernews.tldr: Agentability sends an agent on ten real web information errands every day and publishes every transcript under no-login, no-JavaScript, no-human-help, and no-retry constraints. It also audits 113 websites weekly for agent accessibility signals such as llms.txt, crawler policy, browserless readability, structured data, and MCP support. The project functions as a transparent, continuously refreshed web-agent benchmark, although its fixed operating constraints should be considered when generalizing results.
hackernews.tldr_zh: Agentability 每天让 Agent 执行 10 个真实网页信息任务，并在无登录、无 JavaScript、无人类协助、无重试的约束下公开全部 transcript。它还每周按 llms.txt、爬虫策略、无浏览器可读性、结构化数据和 MCP 支持等指标审计 113 个网站。该项目相当于透明、持续更新的 Web Agent benchmark，但解读结果时必须考虑其固定运行约束。
